name: Tropical Climate
summary: Deep roof overhangs, raised ventilated roofs, sun louvres and lush planting.

design_language.style: tropical climate-responsive factory for Vietnam with deep overhangs and natural ventilation
design_language.primary_material: light warm-grey profiled metal with a ventilated raised roof
design_language.secondary_material: deep steel canopies and aluminium sun louvres
design_language.office_material: recessed glazing shaded by louvres and deep eaves
design_language.accent: timber-look louvres at the office only

environment.weather: bright tropical late morning with scattered cumulus

presentation.landscape_character: lush layered tropical planting with rows of tropical shade trees (sao đen, dầu, bàng) along roads and boundaries
presentation.paving_character: dark asphalt on every external and perimeter road; light-grey industrial concrete with joints, drainage and light dust on internal yards and loading aprons

brief.roof_type: symmetric low-slope gable profiled-metal roof fitted inside LOD100 envelope
